title: Like and not so like
text:
Like and not so like. CONS:
They don't stack well
The plates have black lines from using knives :~/
Dinner plates are much too large (platter size)
The ribbing design holds food when rinsing
PROS:
Love pattern, color and weight

product_metadata.title: getstar Cereal Bowls, Soup Bowls, Ceramic Bowl Set for Kitchen (4 Pcs, 6 inch & 24 oz), Microwave Safe Porcelain Bowl Set of 4, Soup Cereal Salad Rice Ramen Bowl (White)

SPECIAL TEXTURE & 4 COLORS TO CHOOSE: Striped texture and sleek & curved shape - easy to hold and stack, save places for your cupboard; 4 different colors to choose from including white, dark blue, red & gray, add new colors to your kitchen
